title: Boruto: Two Blue Vortex
description: Three years after being forced to leave the Hidden Leaf Village, Boruto Uzumaki returns stronger and more determined than ever. With the world believing that Boruto is the enemy and Kawaki has taken his place, Boruto must confront new threats while uncovering the mysteries surrounding the Divine Trees and the rapidly changing shinobi world. As powerful enemies emerge, Boruto begins a new chapter of his journey while carrying the legacy of Naruto and Sasuke.
author: Masashi Kishimoto / Mikio Ikemoto / Ukyo Kodachi
